Friday Java Ride (Beach Cities Cycling Club)

Redondo Beach, CA · South Bay · Road

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Friday Java Ride (Beach Cities Cycling Club) is a road group ride in Redondo Beach, CA. It rolls every Friday at 9:00 am from Redondo Beach Pier, pedestrian area south of Captain Kidd's. Pace: easy, flat, Level 4 (casual). No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy, flat, Level 4 (casual). It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Friday Java Ride (Beach Cities Cycling Club) group ride

An easy, flat coffee ride to a cafe or bakery in the South Bay or Westside. The club calls it its most social ride and a good first ride for beginners or people getting back into it. The club has a no-drop policy on all rides and runs 13 activities a week at four levels, most from the Redondo pier.
